items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: Another person I really like is the couple Chick and Gayle.

ctx.x: He’s kind of a — I’m not sure what word to use — you don’t hear that much from him and then he comes out with another album.
Yeah. He’s great. Another person I really like is the couple Chick and Gayle.
